action_items: None — all 15 review items verified passing.
critical_code_review_comments: compliance.py _scrub() correctly strips _id and password_hash/hashed_password/access_token/refresh_token but MongoDB query already uses projection {'_id': 0} (L126) — double defense is good. Consider also scrubbing nested Gmail tokens inside uploaded_documents or any other embedded token fields if present.

DELETE /api/compliance/account uses exact-string match on 'DELETE MY ACCOUNT' (case-sensitive, no trim) — matches spec but consider documenting the exact casing in the API docs/frontend hint to avoid user frustration (frontend Settings.js already mirrors this exactly).

deletion_audit stores str(hash(email)) which is Python's salted hash (not deterministic across processes) — fine for non-forensic audit but if regulatory audit requires re-identifying a deletion, use a stable sha256(email+deterministic_salt) instead.
export-data uses .to_list(length=1000) — for power users with >1000 transactions this silently truncates the DPDP export. Either increase limit, paginate, or log a warning when limit is hit.
Grievance submissions are stored in db.grievances but there is no admin-side read endpoint in this batch — acceptable for MVP but flag for next batch (main agent likely aware).

Grievance form success UX confirmed via testid grievance-success — good. No rate limiting on POST /api/compliance/grievance though (public endpoint) — consider adding a simple per-IP throttle to prevent spam abuse post-launch.
